topics.title: What Is DevOps?
topics.summary: Understand DevOps as culture, practice, and tooling that together get changes from idea to production faster and more safely.

topics.title: The Software Delivery Lifecycle
topics.summary: Follow a change from a developer's laptop through build, test, release, deploy, and operate, and see where delays and failures creep in.

topics.title: The Three Ways
topics.summary: Learn the principles of flow, feedback, and continual learning from The Phoenix Project that anchor every DevOps practice.

topics.title: Lean Software Development
topics.summary: Apply lean ideas like eliminating waste, small batches, and fast delivery to how software teams plan and ship work.

topics.title: Linux Command Line Essentials
topics.summary: Navigate servers confidently with ls, cd, grep, find, less, ssh, and journalctl, the daily vocabulary of ops work.

topics.title: Linux Users, Permissions, and Processes
topics.summary: Manage users, file permissions, processes, and systemd services so you can run and troubleshoot software on a Linux server.

topics.title: Bash Scripting Fundamentals
topics.summary: Write scripts with variables, conditionals, loops, and pipes to automate repetitive tasks and glue CI steps together.

topics.title: Networking for DevOps
topics.summary: Understand IP addresses, TCP, DNS, ports, firewalls, and load balancers well enough to debug why a deployed service is unreachable.

topics.title: YAML, JSON, and Config Files
topics.summary: Read and write the YAML and JSON that every pipeline, container, and cluster is configured with, and avoid indentation traps.

topics.title: Version Control with Git
topics.summary: Use commits, branches, merges, and remotes to track changes and collaborate, the foundation of every modern workflow.

topics.title: Branching Strategies
topics.summary: Compare GitFlow, GitHub Flow, and trunk-based development and pick one based on team size and release cadence.

topics.title: Code Review Best Practices
topics.summary: Keep pull requests small, review quickly, give kind and specific feedback, and know what is not worth arguing about.

topics.title: Pair and Mob Programming
topics.summary: Learn when working together at one keyboard multiplies a team's output and when it just slows everyone down.

topics.title: Automated Testing Fundamentals
topics.summary: Understand unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and the test pyramid, so pipelines can tell good changes from broken ones.

topics.title: Build Tools (Maven, Gradle, Make)
topics.summary: See how build tools compile, test, and package code, and which tool each language community relies on.

topics.title: Continuous Integration Fundamentals
topics.summary: Learn why every commit should trigger an automatic build and test run, and why the main branch must always stay green.

topics.title: Continuous Delivery vs Deployment
topics.summary: Distinguish always-shippable from always-shipped, and understand the team maturity needed to move from one to the other.

topics.title: The CALMS Framework
topics.summary: Use Culture, Automation, Lean, Measurement, and Sharing to assess how mature a team's DevOps practice really is.

topics.title: GitHub Actions Pipelines
topics.summary: Build your first real pipeline with workflows, jobs, steps, and runners on the most widely used CI platform.

topics.title: GitLab CI/CD
topics.summary: Configure .gitlab-ci.yml stages, runners, and environments for CI/CD that ships built into the source control platform.

topics.title: Jenkins and Pipeline as Code
topics.summary: Write declarative Jenkinsfiles, use agents, and maintain the self-hosted CI server many enterprises still run.

topics.title: CircleCI and Other CI Platforms
topics.summary: Survey CircleCI, Buildkite, and Drone, and learn the criteria for choosing a CI platform for a team.

topics.title: Artifact Repositories
topics.summary: Store versioned build outputs and proxy dependencies with Nexus, Artifactory, or GitHub Packages so builds are reproducible.

topics.title: Containerization with Docker
topics.summary: Run applications in containers and understand images, layers, and registries, the packaging format of modern ops.

topics.title: Dockerfiles and Multi-Stage Builds
topics.summary: Write Dockerfiles that produce small images, build quickly with layer caching, and never bake secrets into layers.

topics.title: Docker Compose for Local Dev
topics.summary: Run a multi-container stack such as app, Postgres, and Redis locally from a single Compose file.

topics.title: Container Image Best Practices
topics.summary: Harden images with minimal or distroless bases, non-root users, pinned versions, and signing to shrink the attack surface.

topics.title: Cloud Fundamentals for DevOps
topics.summary: Understand virtual machines, regions, networks, IAM, and managed services in a public cloud, the target for most deployments.

topics.title: Terraform Fundamentals
topics.summary: Define cloud infrastructure as code with providers, resources, state, and the plan and apply workflow.

topics.title: Ansible for Configuration Management
topics.summary: Configure fleets of servers with agentless playbooks, roles, and inventories that run the same way every time.

topics.title: Puppet and Chef Overview
topics.summary: Learn the earlier agent-based configuration tools, what they got right, and why agentless approaches became popular.

topics.title: Secrets Management with Vault
topics.summary: Store, lease, and rotate credentials with Vault and dynamic secrets instead of committing .env files to git.

topics.title: Kubernetes Architecture
topics.summary: Learn what the API server, scheduler, etcd, and kubelet each do, and how a request flows through a cluster.

topics.title: Pods, Services, Deployments, ConfigMaps
topics.summary: Deploy a workload using the core Kubernetes objects and understand how they reference and depend on each other.

topics.title: Ingress Controllers
topics.summary: Route external HTTP traffic into a cluster with Ingress rules and controllers such as NGINX, Traefik, or a cloud load balancer.

topics.title: Helm Charts
topics.summary: Package Kubernetes manifests as templated, versioned Helm charts and manage releases, upgrades, and rollbacks.

topics.title: Feature Flags and Toggle Strategies
topics.summary: Decouple deploying code from releasing features using flags, gradual rollouts, and tools like LaunchDarkly or Flagsmith.

topics.title: Blue-Green and Canary Deployments
topics.summary: Reduce release risk by switching between two environments or by sending a small share of traffic to the new version first.

topics.title: Site Reliability Engineering Basics
topics.summary: Learn Google's approach to operations as software: reliability targets, toil reduction, and shared ownership of production.

topics.title: Logging Strategies
topics.summary: Emit structured logs with sensible levels, ship them to ELK or Loki, and know what should never be logged.

topics.title: Metrics with Prometheus
topics.summary: Collect time-series metrics with exporters and scraping, and query them with PromQL to see how systems behave.

topics.title: Visualization with Grafana
topics.summary: Build Grafana dashboards and alerts over your data sources so humans can spot problems at a glance.

topics.title: Distributed Tracing
topics.summary: Follow a single request across microservices with OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or Zipkin to find where latency hides.

topics.title: Application Performance Monitoring
topics.summary: Use turnkey APM tools like Datadog, New Relic, or Dynatrace and weigh their convenience against cost and lock-in.

topics.title: Security in CI/CD
topics.summary: Add SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and signed builds to pipelines to shift security left without slowing delivery.

topics.title: Secrets Scanning
topics.summary: Catch leaked credentials before they ship using gitleaks, pre-commit hooks, and GitHub secret scanning, and respond when one leaks.

topics.title: Container Security Scanning
topics.summary: Find CVEs in images with Trivy, Grype, or Snyk, and set a patching cadence for base images that keeps up.

topics.title: Infrastructure Testing
topics.summary: Test infrastructure code with Terratest, InSpec, and policy checks before it ever touches production.

topics.title: Database Migrations in CI/CD
topics.summary: Version schema changes with Flyway or Liquibase and run them automatically and repeatably as part of every deploy.

topics.title: Zero-Downtime Database Changes
topics.summary: Change live schemas safely with expand and contract, online migrations, backfills, and dual writes while traffic keeps flowing.

topics.title: GitOps with ArgoCD and Flux
topics.summary: Make git the source of truth for clusters so every change is declarative, auditable, and reversible with ArgoCD or Flux.

topics.title: Progressive Delivery
topics.summary: Automate canary promotion and rollback based on live metrics using Argo Rollouts or Flagger.

topics.title: Custom Resource Definitions
topics.summary: Extend the Kubernetes API with your own object types, the foundation every operator is built on.

topics.title: Kubernetes Operators
topics.summary: Encode operational knowledge as controllers that watch custom resources and reconcile the cluster toward the desired state.

topics.title: Service Mesh with Istio
topics.summary: Add mTLS, traffic shaping, and observability with sidecar proxies, and judge whether the operational cost is worth it.

topics.title: Multi-Cluster Kubernetes
topics.summary: Run workloads across many clusters with fleet management tools and cross-cluster networking patterns.

topics.title: SLOs, SLIs, and Error Budgets
topics.summary: Define reliability with measurable indicators and objectives, and use error budgets to decide when to stop shipping.

topics.title: On-Call and PagerDuty
topics.summary: Design on-call schedules, escalation policies, actionable alerts, and runbooks that keep responders effective and sane.

topics.title: Incident Management and Postmortems
topics.summary: Run incidents with severity levels and clear roles, then write blameless postmortems that lead to real fixes.

topics.title: Chaos Engineering
topics.summary: Run hypothesis-driven failure experiments and game days to find weaknesses before real outages find them.

topics.title: Disaster Recovery Drills
topics.summary: Practise region failovers, restore-from-backup tests, and tabletop exercises so recovery works when it is needed.

topics.title: Capacity Planning
topics.summary: Model headroom and growth with basic queueing theory to predict the next bottleneck before users feel it.

topics.title: Platform Engineering and IDPs
topics.summary: Build an Internal Developer Platform that gives every product team a paved road to build, deploy, and operate services.

topics.title: Backstage and Developer Portals
topics.summary: Use Backstage to create a service catalog and templates that make your platform discoverable and self-service.

topics.title: Building a DevOps Culture
topics.summary: Shape incentives, ownership, blamelessness, and team structure so the practices you learned actually stick in an organization.
